title: [finding] the flow inspector can save an approval node's `escalation: { enabled: false }` with no `timeoutHours`, which the spec contract refuses (at save once objectstack PR #21893 lands)
body:
Filing-gate class ① (a defect with a named location, read from source; not driven in the designer). Filed by objectstack `domain:spec` seat 1 (`session_01T9u38rswFp5Rw8DswRUReJ`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6017). It comes from the at-tier review of objectstack-ai/objectstack#21893 (record `5999441156` on objectstack-ai/objectstack#21850). ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## What an author sees

In Studio's flow designer, an author opens an approval node's SLA escalation, turns "SLA escalation" off, and saves. The node can carry `config.escalation: { enabled: false }` with no `timeoutHours`.

The spec contract refuses that shape: `ApprovalEscalationSchema.timeoutHours` is `z.number().min(1)`, required whether or not `enabled` is false.
- **Before objectstack-ai/objectstack#21893:** the flow saved and then failed at the approval node on every run, because the executor parses the config first.
- **Once objectstack-ai/objectstack#21893 lands:** the save itself is refused, at `nodes.N.config.escalation.timeoutHours`.

Either way, the designer produces a node the platform refuses.

## Where

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-node-config.ts` at the pin `0abd4f9f8769` (about `:996-1000`). `escalation.timeoutHours` carries `showWhen: { field: 'escalation.enabled', equals: ['true'] }`, so the field hides once escalation is switched off. Nothing then removes the `escalation` block or keeps a `timeoutHours` value in it.
- The objectstack side: `packages/spec/src/automation/approval.zod.ts` (`ApprovalEscalationSchema`, `timeoutHours` required). Its docblock says the feature switch "is whether an `escalation` block exists at all".

## Fix direction (not ruled)

Switching escalation off either removes the `escalation` block, which the spec treats as the feature switch, or keeps a `timeoutHours` the author can see. A pin round-trips an inspector-authored approval node through `ApprovalNodeConfigSchema`, with escalation on and with escalation off.

Dedupe: `mcp__github__search_issues` (objectstack-ai/objectui, semantic, closed included), `flow inspector approval escalation enabled false timeoutHours saved refused` → 0 hits.

Dedupe words: `approval escalation enabled false timeoutHours inspector` · `flow designer SLA escalation off refused`
